scope: Separate Linux CPU simulation sample, not hardware, WCET, or a deadline guarantee.
order: Two repetitions, with arm order reversed for each condition on the second repetition. BLAS uses one thread. Child pinned to one accessible logical CPU; no other process affinity or scheduler changed.
measured: Unit-preserving motor compute and detector update instance-method wrappers, summed on exactly corresponding 6000 time samples; reset excluded. Report wall and thread CPU p99/max and counts >=1000 us. Require both repetitions' physical signals and alarms bitwise equal and all arms identical physical traces.
